experiment: P3 Tables 1-7 and the LoCoMo column of Table 9 on the 1,540 answerable questions and on all questions, from the same stores
deviations: Run on 5 November 2026, not after 2 December 2026 as the plan's status paragraph says: the first author's decision, to use the time the Mac is available; the supervisor had not been asked.

The first run of this code (commit 74e478f, 5 November 2026) reported 77 mismatches out of 751: all were integer fields with equal values, which the comparison did not read as numbers. The comparison was corrected and the file produced again; the kernel's optional similarity (default unchanged) entered the code between the two runs.

The output also holds the score-combination ablation, K-dependence, the gating contrasts without the conflict penalty and the aggregation caliber, which the plan's table list does not name, because the text around Tables 1-7 quotes them.

weight-ablation.json.experiment: weight ablation: the same 150-candidate pool re-ranked under component weights (no gating)

combination-ablation.json.experiment: score combination: additive vs z-score standardisation vs RRF (k = 60) on the same pool; floor judged on the store score

component-scales.json.experiment: component scales: mean saturated score components of the gold evidence, the additive top 8 and the pool (no gating)

k-dependence.json.experiment: K-dependence: top-k from a top-k call vs the first k of a top-8 call; recall with and without the retrieval floor (no gating; micro over questions)

gating-interference.json.experiment: salience gating ON (DEFAULT) vs OFF (NONE): recall@K and distractor load, per retrieval score mode

salience-sources.json.experiment: salience source (oracle / predicted / shuffled) × gating ON/OFF, plus ON without selective consolidation; macro recall@K

uncertainty.json.experiment: uncertainty of the headline contrasts of P3 §5, the conversation as the unit of dependence: conversation bootstrap (10,000 resamples, percentile 95%) and exact sign-flip randomisation over the paired per-conversation differences

pool-check.json.experiment: coverage of the diagnostic track's 150-candidate pool (chosen by the store's standardised score) and the diagnostic on the whole store, judged on rank alone (micro)

published.what: top 150 under the store score, retrieval floor applied (the published diagnostic track)

pool150RankOnly.what: top 150 under the store score, rank alone

contrasts.key: weights (150-candidate pool, floor): sim-only vs current
weights (whole store, rank alone): sim-only vs current

delivery-check.json.experiment: delivery track without gating: recall@8 (macro) per score mode with the conflict penalty at its default and switched off (1.0); share of top-8 slots penalised; share of questions with a penalised gold item in the scanned head (8 additive, 150 standardised)

gating-penalty-off.json.experiment: gating ON - OFF at K = 8 (macro) under each score mode and salience source, with the conflict penalty switched off (1.0); unit bootstrap and sign-flip test as in uncertainty.json
